subject.title: fix(ai): preserve compat xhigh reasoning effort

question: Should this refreshed branch become the sole canonical implementation for OpenAI-compatible `xhigh` reasoning support, replacing the overlapping older PR?
rationale: Both branches represent the same substantive compatibility direction, but selecting which contributor branch lands is a maintainer ownership and review-continuity decision rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Adopt the refreshed PR
options.body: Treat this branch as canonical because it rebases the prior work and adds the explicit reasoning-effort boundary hardening; then close https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90703 as superseded.

options.title: Retain the earlier PR
options.body: Keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90703 as canonical and close this refreshed duplicate only if maintainers prefer its existing review history and port any unique hardening first.

recommendation.title: Adopt the refreshed PR
recommendation.body: Treat this branch as canonical because it rebases the prior work and adds the explicit reasoning-effort boundary hardening; then close https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90703 as superseded.

likelyOwner.reason: Alex-Govorov authored the six substantive compatibility commits retained by this branch and is the clearest history-backed routing contact for the overlap.
